newsletter.subject: Stocks climb, yields slip
newsletter.text:
MARKETS AT THE CLOSE

| Index | Close | Change |
|---|---|---|
| Meridian 500 | 6,214 | +1.3% |
| Tech 90 | 18,402 | +2.1% |
| 10-year yield | 4.1% | -0.08 |

Stocks rose for a third straight day after a report showed factory output growing faster than expected. Tech shares led, while the 10-year government bond yield slipped to 4.1%.

Oil fell 2% to $71 a barrel.

referenceSummary: Stocks rose for a third straight day after factory output grew faster than expected, with the Meridian 500 up 1.3% to 6,214 and the Tech 90 up 2.1%. The 10-year government bond yield slipped to 4.1%, and oil fell 2% to $71 a barrel.
